content.content:
usage: gnd measure [-h] [--promote DIR] [--populations POPULATIONS]
                   [--labels MANIFEST] [--out OUT] [--format {text,json}]
                   model

Measure the checker's per-constraint false-pass, false-fail and undecided
rates over labelled synthetic populations. Reads the populations `gnd synth`
wrote and their provenance sidecars, verifies the C6 sidecar binding before
scoring, and emits a per-constraint report — three rates, each with its
numerator AND its conditional denominator (C2), never a blended accuracy
number (D-01). Computed OFFLINE from committed artifacts: no timestamp, so two
runs over one corpus reproduce byte-for-byte. Exits 3 on a sidecar-binding
mismatch, 5 on a population that fails to load, 6 on a checker defect (C9), 64
on a corpus mixing models or pool sources (C4).

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --promote DIR         D-14: copy each defect-revealing population and its
                        model into DIR (the adversarial corpus root) and PRINT
                        manifest rows in the locked record shape. The append
                        itself stays a reviewed act — this never edits
                        manifest.yaml
  --populations POPULATIONS
                        output root of a `gnd synth` run (the directory
                        holding index.json)
  --labels MANIFEST     IK3: a gnd-labels/1 manifest of host-labelled
                        populations, instead of --populations. Expected-state
                        mode emits report schema 4 (exit 6 on a checker
                        defect); class mode emits schema 5 agreement cells
                        (exit 0). See docs/reference/measure-labels.md
  --out OUT             write the JSON payload to this path (default: stdout)
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload

input.command: gnd measure model.orm.yaml --labels labels.json --out measure.json --format text; echo "exit=$?"

content.content:
REDACTION applied: 
MEASUREMENT model.orm.yaml [labels=class] populations=8
WORK 16 (ceiling 24)
  constraints[0] [guarded/deontic] fires_on=negative
      fired_on_negative=2/4 fired_on_positive=0/4 silent_on_negative=2/4 silent_on_positive=4/4 vacuous=0/8 unchecked=0/8
  (json written to measure.json)

content.text:
**The written refund rule catches 2 of the 4 flagged weeks, and it never accuses a clean week.**

`gnd measure model.orm.yaml --labels labels.json` printed, for the constraint `g_refund_limit` (guarded, deontic, fires on negative):

- `fired_on_negative=2/4`: it fires on 2 of the 4 flagged weeks.
- `silent_on_negative=2/4`: it stays silent on the other 2 flagged weeks.
- `fired_on_positive=0/4`: it fires on none of the 4 clean weeks.
- `silent_on_positive=4/4`: it is silent on all 4 clean weeks.
- `vacuous=0/8` and `unchecked=0/8`: every week was checked.

GND printed no combined accuracy figure, so none is reported here. The full JSON payload is in `<workspace>/measure.json`.

This is a score only. No proposal was written, so there is nothing to hand to review. The README says the written rule should catch two of the four flagged weeks, which matches the printed result. Its companion "no refund over 500" rule, the one the README says separates the two groups, has not been scored here. I can score it next if you want to compare.
